title: Extraction of PCB18 and Its Hydroxylated Metabolites from Animal Serum
author: Xueshu Li
materials: Dispose of the following materials as indicated: SPE cartridges – Remove the cartridges from the SPE manifold and dispose the content as PCB-contaminated hazardous waste. Place the cartridges in the sink to be washed. Evaporator – Place needles in a glass beaker and combust in the furnace. Tube-A, Tube-B, Tube-C, Tube-D, and other aqueous solutions – dispose as aqueous hazardous waste. Organic solvents (waste tubes with hexanes and 2-propanol) – dispose as organic hazardous waste. All PCB-exposed disposable glassware, foil, GC vials, and gloves – dispose as PCB-contaminated hazardous waste. Serological pipettes – sharps container.
Let the silica gel precipitate to the bottom.
Cap tube-A and the Reference standard.
Invert tube-B for 5 min, then centrifuge.
Cap all vials immediately with a crimp cap.

steps.title: Prepare Glassware and Materials
steps.instruction: Combust silica gel, glass wool, all glassware (cartridges, short and long pipettes, tubes, beaker/volumetric flask, funnel), scalpel, forceps, and spatula.

steps.title: Label and Prepare Sample Tubes
steps.instruction: Label all sample tubes (Tube-A1, A2, etc.; Tube-B1, B2, etc.; Tube-C1, C2, etc.; Tube-D1, D2, etc., and Reference).

steps.title: Prepare Standards
steps.instruction: Remove the Ongoing Recovery and Precision (ORP) standard (PCB18 and 4'-OH-PCB18) and the Surrogate Standard (SS_PCB: d-PCB30; SS_OH-PCB: 4-OH-PCB52) solutions from the freezer and allow them to warm to room temperature for approximately 30 minutes.

steps.title: Initial Sample Spiking and Loading
steps.instruction: Prepare the initial samples in tube-A.

substeps.instruction: Place 0.2 mL of serum in tube-A and record weight.
Spike tube-A OPR samples and the Reference standard with 100 µL of PCB18 standard (100 ng/mL = 10 ng) and 100 µL of 4'-OH-PCB18 standard mixture (100 ng/mL = 10 ng each).
Add 100 µL each of d-PCB30 (SS_PCB, 100 ng/mL) and 4-OH-PCB52 (SS_OH-PCB, 100 ng/mL) to all tube-A samples (method blanks, tissue blanks, tissues, OPR, and Reference standard), totaling 10 ng each.

steps.title: Sample Extraction and Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Perform the initial extraction and purification of the serum samples in tube-A.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL of 1% KCl solution to tube-A.
Add 1 mL of 6 M HCl to tube-A and vortex for 10 s.
Add 1% KCl to remaining tube-A to a final volume of 3 mL.
Add 5 mL of 2-propanol to tube-A and vortex for 10 s.
Add 5 mL of hexanes:MTBE mixture (1:1, v/v) to tube-A.
Cap tube-A with screw caps containing a PTFE septum.
Transfer the organic phase (top layer) from tube-A to tube-B using new long pipettes.
Re-extract tube-A with 3 mL of hexanes:MTBE (1:1, v/v), vortex for 10 s, and centrifuge.
Transfer the organic phase (top layer) from tube-A to tube-B with a short pipette.

steps.title: Secondary Purification and Concentration
steps.instruction: Further purify the extract in tube-B and concentrate into tube-C.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL of 1% KCl solution to tube-B.
Transfer the organic phase (top layer) from tube-A to tube-B with new long pipettes (Note: text repeats this action).
Re-extract tube-B with 3 mL of hexanes, vortex, and centrifuge.
Transfer the organic layer (top layer) from tube-B to tube-C.
Evaporate solvent in tube-C under a gentle stream of nitrogen to ~100 µL.

steps.title: Derivatization with Diazomethane
steps.instruction: Perform derivatization of the samples in tube-C within a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 drops of methanol to tube-C (excluding the Reference standard), vortex for 5 seconds.
Remove diazomethane solution in diethyl ether from the freezer and place in an ice box in the fume hood.
Using a 10 mL serological pipette, add ~0.5 mL of diazomethane to each sample and 1 mL to the Reference standard.
Cap tube-C and store in an explosion-proof refrigerator at 4-8 °C for at least 3 h or overnight (~16 h).
Evaporate excess ether and diazomethane under a gentle nitrogen flow until no yellow color remains (~200 µL).
Evaporate the Reference standard to near dryness (~50 μL) and set aside.

steps.title: Prepare SPE Cartridges
steps.instruction: Assemble and condition the SPE cartridges.

substeps.instruction: Place clean SPE cartridges into the manifold ports with uncombusted tubes at the bottom to collect waste.
Add glass wool to the SPE cartridge and pack it down with the end of a glass pipette.
Add 0.2 g of silica gel to the cartridges using a combusted small glass funnel.
Rinse the cartridge with 2 mL of hexanes-DCM (1:1, v/v) using a long pipette.
Mix hexanes-DCM (1:1, v/v) with acidified silica gel (5:1) in a small beaker, add the suspension to the cartridge, and mix with a short glass pipette tip to eliminate air bubbles.

steps.title: SPE Loading and Elution
steps.instruction: Load the derivatized extracts onto the SPE cartridge and elute into tube-D.

substeps.instruction: Replace waste tubes at the bottom with freshly labeled, combusted tube-D and align tube-C in the rack.
Pass ~3 mL of hexanes-DCM (1:1, v/v) into the bottom waste tube, ensuring solvent level remains above the acidified silica gel.
Slowly load extracts from tube-C into the SPE cartridge using long glass pipettes.
Rinse tube-C twice (2 x 0.5 mL) with hexanes:DCM (1:1, v/v) and pass the wash through the cartridge.
Add additional hexanes-DCM (1:1, v/v; total volume ~9 mL) until the eluent in tube-D reaches ~10 mL, then open the SPE valve completely to flush residual solvent into tube-D.
Maintain a controlled drop-by-drop flow by regulating vacuum pressure; ensure solvent level remains above acidified silica gel throughout.

steps.title: Final Concentration and Internal Standard Spiking
steps.instruction: Concentrate the final extract and add internal standards.

substeps.instruction: Turn off the manifold vacuum and remove tube-D.
Concentrate samples in tube-D under a gentle stream of nitrogen to ~200 µL.
Add 3 mL of hexanes to tube-D and concentrate again under nitrogen to ~50 µL for solvent exchange.
Remove Internal Standards (IS) from the freezer and allow to warm to room temperature (~30 min).
Add 100 µL of internal standard (IS; PCB204, 100 ng/mL) to tube-D and the Reference standard using a single-channel pipette.

steps.title: Final Sample Preparation for GC
steps.instruction: Prepare the final vials for gas chromatographic analysis.

substeps.instruction: Label GC vials with sample numbers.
Transfer extracts from tube-D and the Reference standard with a long pipette to combusted crimp-style GC vials.
Rinse tube-D with hexanes and combine with the extract in the GC vials to reach a final volume of ~0.6 mL.
Vortex tube-D.
Prepare a solvent blank by filling a GC vial with the same hexanes used for extractions.

steps.title: Storage and Analysis
steps.instruction: Store and manage samples according to stability requirements.

substeps.instruction: Store all samples, including the solvent blank, in a solvent-proof -20°C freezer (do not use a regular freezer).
Recap all samples after instrument analysis to minimize evaporation; refill solvent to ~0.6 mL if necessary.
Use the provided Excel worksheet to calculate levels of PCB18 and its hydroxylated metabolites after GC analysis.
Wash used glass cartridges with soapy water and a brush, dry, and combust in the furnace.
Combust used needles in the furnace.
